title: Incident #4541 — Morning Data Pipeline Failure
scenario: The analytics team reports that the daily sales summary is missing data from the last hour. Find the bug.
code:
SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM
    orders
WHERE
    order_time >= CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY
    product_id;

options.text: The query should filter by order_time using a specific time zone.
The query is missing a condition to include orders from the last hour.
The GROUP BY clause should also include order_time.
The SUM function is incorrectly aggregating data.

explanation: The bug is that the query only filters for today's orders, but it doesn't account for the last hour of sales data. Adding a condition to include orders from the last hour will resolve the issue. Use 'order_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'' to fix it.
